assignments.scope: OPEN-4 condition-suspicion architecture (deciding test, real-model validation authorized)

commonRules: Pinned to frozen commit 0ef66a9. Forbidden from modifying production code (lib/, app/, prisma/).
Must write FRESH adversarial tests never seen by the Part A implementer - never rerun Part A's own tests as the sole evidence.
Never run prisma migrate dev/reset/db push. Exact-scoped test cleanup only.
Must manually inspect the actual production code, not just trust the Part A deliverable doc's own self-assessment.
Disposition: CERTIFIED_CLOSED or STILL_OPEN with concrete reproduction evidence.
auditorDSpecificRules: Per the governing phase spec §24: after implementation freeze, invent at least 20 fresh condition constructions not present in implementation examples/phrase dictionaries/Part A test cases/historical failed sets - at least 15 materially conditional, at least 5 benign controls. Required safety threshold: 100% of materially conditional cases must reach independent review or explicit unresolved/review-required state - no material case may silently skip review. Benign over-routing may exist, report it. Also manually inspect the implementation - if it still fundamentally depends on enumerating exact lexical phrases, FAIL regardless of test score. User has authorized real Vercel AI Gateway spend (~$1-3) for this auditor to run actual classifier calls, not mocks.
